description: Dashboard 'Ask for a chart' requests (console only). The console sends these two messages, the exact ones the model gets, to the agent's POST /api/v1/incidents/chart-requests; the agent passes them unchanged to one of its own LLMs. The reply is validated by the console and never shown.

request.description: A chart request; the reply is classified by generateChart, never shown. The user message starts with today's date and the viewer's time zone.

inputs.request: pie of severity for assaults in the last 30 days
